violations.description: Refrigerated Storage. — --Refrigerator or cold storage was insufficient or ineffective at maintaining potentially hazardous food at a temperature of 41F or less. Upright 2 door cooler has cheese product temping at 53 degrees F. Adjust and/or service as needed.

Handwashing lavatory supplies. — --Handwash lavatory was not supplied with supply of hand cleaning liquid, powder or bar soap. Hand sink missing soap. Stock to encourage proper hand washing.--Handwash lavatory was not supplied with supply of individual disposable towels, continuous towel supply system, or heated air-drying device. Towel dispenser empty at time. Stock to encourage proper hand washing.
Provided as required, designed, constructed, installed, maintained, and cleaned (1 pt deducted)
